name: bin-map
title: Cell map
description: Grid of cells by group and sub-group. Grey cells agree; tinted cells show the direction and size of the difference.
needs: A numeric measure. Records with group [row, sub-row] and attrs.slot for the position along the row; attrs.cost optionally prices the difference.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Grid of {unit} by group and sub-group. A grey cell agrees. A tinted cell differs, in the colour of the side that is higher.
text.chartSub: Tolerance is {tolerance} per {unitOne}. Select a cell or a group.

options.name: colourScale
options.description: Percentage difference at which cell colour reaches full intensity.
